4. Plaint case, in short, is that land of RS Khatian Nos. 197, 261 and 783 as described in schedule 'Ka' originally belonged to Nani Bala, who transferred said land to Bimal Krishna Debnath. Bimal Debnath then transferred the land to Ishaque Ali Miah, predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs by a registered 'Kabala' dated 12-4-1973. 

 6. Land of RS Khatian No. 128 belonged to Rebuti Ranjan Ghosh, who transferred said land to Ishaque Ali by a registered 'Kabala' dated 18-12-1972. Ishaque Ali purchased the land in the 'Benami' of defendant No. 2 Ramendra Nath. Similarly, while Indobhushan and Sarala Bibia were owners in possession of land of RS Khatian No. 147 they transferred said land to Ishaque Ali by a registered deed dated 1-4-1974 in the name of 'Benami' of said defendant No.2. 

 27. Kabala dated 12-4-1973, Exhibit 1 shows transfer by Bimal Krishna Debnath to Ishaque Ali of 2.44 acres of plot Nos. 431, 432 and 659 of SA Khatian No. 324, 23 decimals of plot No. 520 of SA Khatian No. 277 and 22 decimals of plot No. 520 in total 2.89 acres. By sale deed dated 28-12-1972, exhibit 1(a) said land appears to be transferred to Bimal Krishna Debnath by Nani Bala Ghoshe. Sale deed dated 1578-1987, Exhibit 1 (b) shows transfer of 53.75 decimals of plot No. 659 of SA Khatian No. 324 by Abdus Salek (defendant No.4) to plaintiff Nos. 1 to 7. Sale deed 28-12-1972, exhibit 1(c) evidences transfer of 67 decimals of plot Nos. 431 and 432 of SA Khatian 509 by Rebuti Romen Ghosh and sale deed dated 1-4-1974, exhibit 1(d) transferring 73 decimals of plot No. 431, 432, 433 and 658 of SA Khatian 147 by Indobhushan to Ramendra Nath Biswash, son of Birendra Nath. Said deeds cover 4.8275 acres of land. 

 28. But the plaintiffs claimed 4.44 acres only. Of the suit land, in Item 5 of schedule "Ka' the plaintiffs claimed 1.46 acre of SA Khatian No. 147. In support or 1.46 acre, I find only evidence adduced is a deed dated 1-4-1974, Exhibit-1 (d), which is claimed to have been purchased by their father Ishaque Ali in the 'Benami' of defendant No. 2 Ramendra Nath and covers 73 decimals of land only, For the rest of 7 decimals no other evidence was adduced. Similarly, the plaintiffs claimed that 67 decimals of SA Khatian No. 509, was purchased by Ishaque Ali in, the 'Benami' of said defendant No. 2.
